is: The route tree: a root layout that resolves whoami once per render and loads the tokens, base styles and fonts; a `(public)` group (landing, `/login`) under today's plain header; and an auth-gated `(session)` group inside the Explorer frame.
conventions: Loads and actions are the seam's consumers — `runApi(program)` then branch; never `Effect` in a route file.
Forms are progressive-enhancement-first: `superValidate` + the effect adapter in the load, a form action for the POST, `problemMessage` for backend failures on the same form.

fs.name: (public)/
fs.role: landing (`/`) and `/login` under SessionHeader — URLs unchanged by the group; login's handle form action → PDS redirect, callback-errors.ts maps axum's ?error= codes to copy

fs.name: (session)/
fs.role: the auth-gated group (accounts, logout) inside the Explorer frame (AppShell), behind a redirect-to-login layout guard

fs.name: +error.svelte
fs.role: errors outside the frame, rendered by status and route alone (ErrorView), never by message

fs.name: +layout.server.ts
fs.role: one whoami per server render shared via layout data (reusing the sign-in gate's answer on (session) routes); unreachable backend degrades to signed-out, contract breakage still 500s

fs.name: +layout.svelte
fs.role: the root — tokens.css, base.css, the self-hosted fonts and the favicon; no header (each group brings its own)

fs.name: error.svelte.spec.ts
fs.role: proves the public error page never shows the error's own text ($app/state mocked)

fs.name: layout.server.spec.ts
fs.role: spec for the root layout load (the `+` is dropped in route spec names)

fs.name: mock/
fs.role: dev-only mock signin (routes/mock/signin/+server.ts) — completes the login redirect loop with no OAuth/PDS/backend; fails closed with a 404 unless mock mode is enabled
